incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED — High GPU queue growth in us-west-2 (spot autoscale failures). Paging @Priya (SRE Oncall). Detected 2026-03-15T14:12:56Z. Impact: request latency > 30s, throttling on generation routes. Links: https://dash.redwood/alerts/2370009876

Priya (SRE Oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge now. Can someone drop the current autoscaler logs?

Liam (Eng Runtime): copying logs — looks like repeated preemptions triggered scale-down during warmup windows. Autoscaler failed to provision fallback pools. snippet:
```
autoscaler: scaleEvent e-4721 type=scaleDown reason=undervolume
pool-manager: mark_preemptible node=spot-gpu-22 status=preempted
fallback: allocation_err code=NoCompatibleCapacity
```

Marcos (Infra): We're seeing GCE preemption spikes in usw2-spot. Cloud API returns zero capacity for our usual fallback zones for ~3m. Might be quota exhaustion on the spare reserved pool.

Jenny (Ops): Customer-facing queues for generation-api are growing (Q size ~6200). Throttles engaged: 503s for short jobs, some timeouts bubbled. Reducing rate-limiters buys <30s.

Priya (SRE Oncall): Action plan: 1) Pause autoscaler scale-downs (apply temp flag). 2) Force create dedicated warm spare instances in dedicated-gpu pool. 3) Enable graceful fallback to smaller model shard (low-priority). Assigning tasks: Marcos take (2), Liam take (3), I'll do (1) and bridge.

Marcos (Infra): Trying to spin reserved instances in dedicated-gpu-usw2-1. Command run:
```
cloudctl compute instances create --pool dedicated-gpu-usw2-1 --count 6 --gpu=v100
```
Response: rateLimitExceeded for quota "GPUs (v100)" in project-redwood-usw2. Requesting increase is slow. Trying alternate region: dedicated-gpu-use1-2.

Liam (Eng Runtime): Preparing model fallback: patching router config to allow smaller-variant model-7b-quant for non-SLA traffic. Patch:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policy
body: {"route":"generation","fallback_models":["model-7b-quant"]}
```
This will avoid spinning GPUs for low-priority jobs.

Renee (Customer Success): Heads-up: two customers with heavy batch jobs (acct: zeta-inc, gamma-ai) already reported timeouts. I'll message zeta-inc with ETA ~30-45m and offer job reruns.

Priya (SRE Oncall): I've flipped the autoscaler flags: disabled scale-down, increased minInstances for spot pools to current+3 to avoid immediate churn. Command: /run-config autoscaler set --disable-scale-down=true --min-instances=12

incident-bot: NOTE: autoscaler config change recorded in audit (cfg-9832).

Jenny (Ops): Queue drain rate improved after fallback routing: Q size down to ~4200 after 6m. But latency still high for L>2048 token jobs.

Marcos (Infra): Dedicated spin-up in us-east succeeded: 6 nodes came up in dedicated-gpu-use1-2 but network egress limits cause slower warmup of model artifacts. Copy error seen:
```
artifact-sync: timeout copying s3://models/model-13b -> /mnt/model (http 504)
```
Working on increased parallel fetch and proxy retries.

Liam (Eng Runtime): Temporary hotfix: enable streaming KV cache warmup to mitigate cold-start token cost. Patch applied, rolling restart on routing workers minimal.

Priya (SRE Oncall): Summary so far: autoscaler prevented oscillation, dedicated nodes partially available (region swap), fallback routing reduced pressure. Remaining open: artifact sync timeouts and quota-limited capacity in primary spot zone.

Renee (Customer Success): Update to zeta-inc: "We've routed lower-priority jobs to quantized fallback models and added capacity in an alternate region. Expect improvement over next 30–45m; we'll follow up when fully resolved." They replied: "Thanks — please keep us posted, this hit our nightly ingest"

Sam (Product): Need to capture impacted endpoints and SLA classes for postmortem and billing credits. Priya, can you annotate impacted routes?

Priya (SRE Oncall): Noted. Impacted: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.stream (long-context jobs), dedicated SLI breach for 99th latency > 10s on premium tier during window. Marking for incident report.

Marcos (Infra): Artifact sync fixed by switching to parallel fetch+retry and switching to us-east object proxy. Model artillery prewarm started — estimate full warm in ~12m.

Jenny (Ops): Queue size now ~750, tokens/sec back to normal for small jobs. Throttling metrics trending down.

Liam (Eng Runtime): Rolling revert of temporary fallback at noon? We should keep fallback policy active until artifacts fully warm (I'll coordinate).

Priya (SRE Oncall): I'm handing off to oncall second for long tail monitoring in 30m. Leaving the bridge open for another 40m. Escalation: if queue >1000 again, re-alert and @Marcos.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations implemented. Current impact: degraded performance for large generations only. Next update scheduled +20m.

Renee (Customer Success): Noted by customers: gamma-ai asked about root cause — I'll hold off public post until we have a timeline and root cause (probable spot preemptions + quota fallback failure).

Sam (Product): Requesting post-incident action items: 1) add autoscaler safety: don't scaleDown during preemption storms; 2) pre-reserve tiny warm pool in multiple regions; 3) artifact prefetch parallelization; 4) alert threshold adjustments.

Priya (SRE Oncall): Agreed. Adding to incident record. Handing off now to Marcos (secondary). Thanks team.

Marcos (Infra): Taking monitoring lead. Will follow up in #incidents-summary with timeline and infra logs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (provisional) — queue drained and SLAs stabilizing. Please file postmortem in the incidents tracker and tag #postmortems when ready.

Priya (SRE Oncall): Closing bridge. Reassigning to oncall-followup for RCA and customer communication draft.

Jenny (Ops): :white_check_mark: Good job getting warm spares up and routing fallback.

Renee (Customer Success): I'll coordinate customer comms and credits once RCA is posted.

Sam (Product): Adding to roadmap: cross-region warm spares + autoscaler safety heuristics.

Liam (Eng Runtime): Will prepare a small test harness to simulate preemption storm and ensure fallback path works end-to-end.

Marcos (Infra): Will open infra ticket for quota request and regional warm-pool provisioning. Ticket: INFRA-8247."
